about_the_game:
This official guide will help you get the most out of your playing time in To Be A King. You will see what you need to do in order to unlock scenes, get achievements, and not miss out on all the content in the game. Over 200 pages of information on Volume 2 of To Be A King is here.

NOTE: This guide contains information for Volume 2 - Part 1. When Volume 2 - Part 2 is released in the future, this guide will be updated to include that information.



  • A walkthrough covering how to unlock all the scenes in the scene gallery & get all the Steam achievements in Volume 2
  • Detailed information on all the love interests and many other characters in the game
  • Exclusive renders not seen before in full high resolution
  • Playing advice from the developer himself
  • Get a detailed explanation of the different points systems in the game
  • Find out how to unlock every love interest



All of this as a PDF you can refer to while you play the game.

content_descriptors.notes: The contains contains mature language and nudity. It also contains graphic depictions of sexual activity, including oral, vaginal, and other sexual activity.
